content: Java WebSocket options: Java-WebSocket (barebones, no framework needed, good for lightweight custom game servers), Spring WebSocket (best if already using Spring Boot, has STOMP pub/sub and Security integration, virtual threads on Java 21+ help concurrency), Javalin (lightweight, simple WS handlers), Jetty/Netty (lower-level, more control). For small course project, Spring Boot + spring-websocket or plain Java-WebSocket are both reasonable; Spring gives more batteries-included (DI, JPA for persistence) which helps a solo dev deliver faster.
